component.name: Dendro
component.summary: Find out what is using your disk space

description.p: Dendro is a fast disk space analyzer in the spirit of WizTree. It scans a drive or folder in parallel and shows where the space went as a sortable folder tree, a list of the largest files, a breakdown by file type and a cushion treemap.

ul.li: Very fast, multi-threaded scanning that works on every Linux filesystem
Shows every file, including hidden files and folders
Counts hard links once and does not follow symbolic links
Optional scanning as administrator to include protected folders
Open, reveal, copy the path of, trash or delete items directly
Follows the system light/dark style and accent colour
